name: Vollert SMART SET shuttering robot
summary: Gantry shuttering robot for pallet circulation plants that takes shutters from a magazine and sets them on the pallet from CAD data, and scans the pallet to pick the shutters off again after curing. Made by Vollert Precast Solutions in Weinsberg, Germany.

germany.statusNote: German maker; sold on request as part of precast plant projects through Vollert's sales team in Weinsberg. No price published. Running at the Oschatz concrete plant in Saxony.

sellers.name: Vollert Precast Solutions GmbH
sellers.note: Heidenbaumstraße 4, 74189 Weinsberg, Germany. Price on request.

specs.label: Shuttering
specs.value: places shutters on the pallet from CAD data
specs.quote: Shuttering robots that work fully automatically place the shutters onto the pallet with a high degree of precision according to the CAD data provided.

specs.label: Shutter supply
specs.value: magazine with the shutter types and lengths set for the plant
specs.conditions: other shutters are set by hand at other workstations
specs.quote: The types and lengths of shutters that have been specified for the special circuit are kept in a magazine.

specs.label: Demoulding
specs.value: removes shutters it finds by scanning the pallet
specs.quote: The robot is also able to remove shutters, which it detects by scanning the pallets.

specs.label: Embedded parts
specs.value: sets magnets for electric outlets (Oschatz line)
specs.quote: The shuttering profiles are positioned at high traversing speed, and embedded parts such as magnets for electric outlets are set in place

notes: Gantry (portal) robot over the pallet line, not an arm on a mobile base; arms = 1 gripper head.
Vollert also sells a large plotter that marks shutter layout and inbuilt parts on the pallet, and a SMART STORE magazine robot that stores the shutters.
Speed, accuracy and shutter weight are not given on the pages read.
